fusions.name: Calculated Prick
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of arcana at the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage. Its damage rises +8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%). It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Final Word
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It then leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited Twice
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Motion
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
